text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Dedicated pool 'solo-enterprise-vpc' GPU capacity pressure — single tenant saturation (tenant=soloenter-77). Queue length >120, mean token latency spiking, error rate rising. Paging @priyaa-oncall @sre-jamie
priyaa-oncall: on it. joining call, creating incident thread.
sre-jamie: joining. quick question — can we evict anything from this pool?
eng-runtime-alex: no — this is a single-tenant dedicated pool (VPC). eviction not allowed. options: emergency burst, model degradation (quantized variant), concurrency caps / queueing, or route to fallback region if model compatible.
ops-lead-carlos: what are tradeoffs for emergency burst?
eng-runtime-alex: burst = spin up temporary nodes. Cost ~4x infra while active. Cold start ~2-3min for nodes, then per-token latency same. Quantized model reduces GPU memory and throughput but may increase token latency ~10-20%. Queueing reduces errors but increases end-to-end latency.
account-zoe: pinged customer primary. They are seeing 500s and demand immediate fix. Their contract allows emergency bursts with prior notice; they prefer we proceed if it reduces errors.
support-maya: CS on call with the customer's SRE, reporting timeouts on audio-transcription endpoint. They're about to throttle clients if it continues.
priyaa-oncall: proposal: enable 30m emergency burst immediately to stabilize, apply a temporary concurrency cap to slow new sessions, ask the customer to throttle non-critical jobs. After stable, set autoscale policy and add lower-cost quantized model variant.
sre-jamie: +1. I'll take action on burst. @eng-runtime-alex please ensure KV cache warmup strategy for new nodes.
eng-runtime-alex: starting burst request now:
```bash
redwoodctl infra burst --pool solo-enterprise-vpc --add-nodes 4 --gpu-type g5x --duration 30m --reason "single-tenant saturation"
```
ops-lead-carlos: putting a soft concurrency cap: `redwoodctl pool set-concurrency --pool solo-enterprise-vpc --max-rps 40` to reduce queue growth.
incident-bot: Burst request submitted (id=burst-554). Provisioning nodes. Notifying billing and infra teams.
priyaa-oncall: created INC ticket INC-35432 for follow-up/postmortem + billing note.
account-zoe: customer verbally approves emergency burst for 30 minutes. They will start throttling background batch jobs now.
support-maya: customer confirms traffic drop ~3 minutes after throttle. Still seeing initial errors but backlog clearing.
sre-jamie: new nodes are up. pool GPU util down from 99% -> 62%. 95th p95 latency returning to normal.
eng-runtime-alex: KV cache priming in progress — some cold starts observed, will stabilize in ~5m. Switching slow models to quantized variants is queued as follow-up.
priyaa-oncall: removing paging ring for now — monitoring only. Action items: 1) follow up with customer to set autoscale or stricter rate limits 2) add a quantized model variant to the customer's catalog 3) review burst policy and billing flow 4) postmortem and RCA.
ops-lead-carlos: marking incident as mitigated. Keeping channel open for 2 hours for watch.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated — severity reduced. Please complete the incident template: https://redwood/internal/incidents/INC-35432
